instruction: Use ug-document extract on the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov 2-5.pdf. Query: extract every billed work date with its first start time, last end time, total billed hours and any hourly rate printed on the invoice. Return the values as a table with Date | Start | End | Billed hours, plus the hourly rate and currency.

Use ug-surveillance cameras to list the cameras and find the camera named Front Door. Confirm for the helper: the user has confirmed the camera recognises faces and may be used to check working hours, so it is allowed to be used for this check. Return the camera id and name.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline on the Front Door camera (location Entrance), timezone America/New_York, start-time 2026-11-02 00:00, end-time 2026-11-02 23:59, topic Human, identity-type all, limit 200. The user has confirmed the camera recognises faces and may be used to check hours. Return every event with its time, and the first and last seen times for the day.
